author: Zephyr I
title: Cosine LR schedule (5% warmup, end 0.1×) — no-time, wd=0.0 (BASE_SEED=42)
abstract: Replace constant LR with warmup+cosine decay on the PG default (no-time). Keep wd=0.0 and all other settings fixed to isolate schedule effects. BASE_SEED=42.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/zephyr/submissions')
from double_step_notime_core import create_network as base_create_network
from ray import tune
import optax

BASE_SEED = 42

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([4e-4]),   # match ID 394 baseline (wd=0.0)
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.5]),
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([32]),
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([64]),
        'conv_lstm_features': tune.choice([64]),
        'dilation': tune.choice([6]),
        'bottleneck_ratio': tune.choice([0.28]),
    }

def create_network(hparams):
    return base_create_network(hparams)

def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 4e-4):
    total_updates = 39062
    warmup_steps = int(0.05 * total_updates)        # 5% warmup
    decay_steps  = max(1, total_updates - warmup_steps)
    schedule = optax.warmup_cosine_decay_schedule(
        init_value=0.0,
        peak_value=learning_rate,
        warmup_steps=warmup_steps,
        decay_steps=decay_steps,
        end_value=learning_rate * 0.1,
    )
    return optax.chain(
        optax.clip_by_global_norm(1.0),
        optax.adamw(learning_rate=schedule, weight_decay=0.0),
    )
